request.style: English, hymn, warm female solo voice with soft choir backing, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, flute, gentle, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Praise you servants of the Lord
Lift up your voices high
Praise the name of the Lord
Let the song fly

[Pre-Chorus]
From this time forth
And forevermore
The blessing endures
Evermore

[Chorus]
Blessed be the name of the Lord
From rising sun to setting light
His glory shines without end
In the day and in the night

[Verse]
High above all nations stands He
His glory lifts to the sky
Who is like the Lord our God
Enthroned on high

[Pre-Chorus]
Who is like the Lord our God
Enthroned on high
Who is like the Lord our God
Enthroned on high

[Chorus]
Blessed be the name of the Lord
From rising sun to setting light
His glory shines without end
In the day and in the night

[Bridge]
He stoops down to look upon
The heavens and the earth below
The Lord is high above all nations
His glory is the show

[Chorus]
Blessed be the name of the Lord
From rising sun to setting light
His glory shines without end
In the day and in the night

[Outro]
Hallelujah
Praise the name of the Lord
